post_run_amendment.change: The descriptive v1.0 baseline values were reconciled to the evaluator's exact reference-relevant population. The collapse diagnostic was also corrected to inspect model-origin predictions, so deterministic-gate rows cannot hide a model collapse.
unchanged: final rejection (the independent scope and accuracy checks already failed)

experimental_change.problem: v1.0 scored option letters at the user/assistant boundary, where the pinned chat model first emits a shared assistant whitespace/preamble token rather than an answer letter
experimental_change.prefix_derivation: render every complete candidate reply with the pinned tokenizer and retain only the exact shared partial-assistant prefix
experimental_change.candidate_score: one candidate-specific option-letter token after the derived Answer: prefix
experimental_change.order_control: average semantic log probabilities across every cyclic label order so each semantic class occupies each letter position once

interpretation.reference: deterministically coarsened GPT-5.6 Sol silver labels
interpretation.claim_limit: development agreement, not human-ground-truth accuracy or confirmatory out-of-sample performance
